rule.title: APFS purgeable space

regen.story: Nothing to regenerate: macOS frees purgeable space on its own under pressure.

rule.note: Finder counts purgeable space as free, df does not. macOS frees it by itself when the disk fills.

rule.title: Local iOS device backups

regen.story: A new backup is made the next time the device is connected and backed up.
regen.cost: none, while the device still works

rule.note: A backup may be the only copy of a device. Delete one in Finder ▸ (device) ▸ Manage Backups.

rule.title: Empty Trash

regen.story: Not regenerable: the Trash is the undo buffer.

rule.note: Permanent: the point of no return for everything regrow, and you, moved to the Trash before.

regen.story: Only unreferenced packages are pruned; anything needed re-downloads.

regen.cost: first build per project slower; no network

rule.title: Simulator runtimes

regen.story: Xcode downloads a runtime again on demand (Settings ▸ Components).
regen.cost: a download of several GiB per runtime

rule.note: Existing simulators of a deleted runtime stop booting until it is downloaded again.

rule.title: Docker volumes (kept)

rule.title: Docker dangling named volumes

regen.story: Not regenerable: the tarball in regrow staging is the recovery copy (docker volume create, then untar).
regen.cost: data is gone for good once staging is cleared

rule.note: Named volumes hold real data. Each one is exported to a tarball in regrow staging before it is removed.

rule.title: Archived project folders

regen.story: Cloned again from its remote, if it has one; work that was never pushed is gone.
regen.cost: a clone per project; whatever was never pushed

rule.note: Check that each project is pushed somewhere before it goes.

regen.story: Repopulated automatically by the next go build.
regen.cost: next builds slower once; no network

rule.title: node_modules in project trees

regen.story: npm, yarn or pnpm install recreates it from the project's lockfile.

rule.note: Pick projects you are not working in: reinstalling is one command but takes minutes each.
